# Mandatory Requirements Assessment

| # | Requirement | Candidate |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | Python | ✅ Met |
| 2 | SQL | ✅ Met |
| 3 | Linux administration | ✅ Met |
| 4 | Git | ✅ Met |
| 5 | REST API design | ✅ Met |
| 6 | Unit testing | ✅ Met |
| 7 | CI pipelines | ✅ Met |
| 8 | Docker, Kubernetes, Terraform, Ansible, Helm | ❌ Not met (none listed) |
| 9 | Kafka | ❌ Not met |
| 10 | GraphQL | ❌ Not met |

**Mandatory match: 7 of 10 = 70%**

Item 8 bundles five technologies into one numbered requirement. I counted it as one item, following the posting's numbering. If you count each technology separately, the match falls to 7 of 14, or 50%.

## ⚠️ Warning: Below Cutoff

The candidate's mandatory match of **70%** is below your **78% cutoff**. As you instructed, I have not evaluated the nice-to-have requirements.

**Gaps:** The candidate has no listed experience with containerization, orchestration, or infrastructure-as-code (Docker, Kubernetes, Terraform, Ansible, Helm), event streaming (Kafka), or GraphQL.
